verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's marketing names AI-powered capabilities, Grafana Assistant and Investigations (grafana-docs-45). The knowledge graph claims to generate 'insights about issues' by connecting metrics, logs, and traces (grafana-docs-44), and natural-language understanding of production systems is advertised (grafana-docs-8). Together these point toward AI-assisted investigation, but only through thin, claim-level mentions, with nothing showing the AI starting from an alert or error and proposing a probable root cause. Missing for 10: documentation of AI investigation triggered from an alert or error, explicit root-cause hypothesis output, detail on how Investigations works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
